effects.title: Tools for Tomorrow
effects.text: Cool the metal before loosening the clamp. Open the box last.

effects.title: Tools for Tomorrow — recovered
effects.text: Finish this level half to keep the recovery. Then return to The Smith in the Waystation.

effects.title: Food for the Refuge
effects.text: The loaded basket needs 8 on the other side. The weights are 3, 5 and 7. Use only the weights you need.

effects.title: Food for the Refuge — recovered
effects.text: Finish this level half to keep the recovery. Then return to Quartermaster in the Waystation.

effects.title: A Kinder Trail
effects.text: Tracks leave the old grove to the west. Round pads and four toes point toward the trapped animals. One route follows roots; another climbs the low logs.

effects.title: A different visitor
effects.text: These prints have a split hoof. A deer came here for fallen fruit. Follow the four-toed paw marks farther west.

effects.title: Two trails
effects.text: One animal stayed beside the roots. Another trail turns toward the old raised cage. Check both before returning to the Beastkeeper.

effects.title: A trap made safe
effects.text: The animal is free. Check the other trail too. Finish Black Woods to keep this rescue, then report to the Beastkeeper.

effects.title: Both animals are free
effects.text: Finish Black Woods and enter the boss clearing to keep this rescue. Then report to the Beastkeeper in the Waystation. You do not need to lead the animals through the level.

effects.title: A trap made safe
effects.text: The animal is free. Check the other trail too. Finish Black Woods to keep this rescue, then report to the Beastkeeper.

effects.title: The old back step
effects.text: Mud has worn a line past the plant pot behind the house. One board has a small bird scratched into its edge.

effects.title: A familiar hiding place
effects.text: The plant pot slides aside. A loose board covers a shallow space under the back step.

effects.title: The wooden bird
effects.text: The little wooden bird is safe. Finish Homefields and enter Black Woods to keep it. Then bring it to Thomas in the Waystation.
